title: The Double Agent
logline: A burned spy discovers their handler has been selling them out to the enemy, and hires a pilot to intercept the handler's extraction shuttle.

roles.description: Paranoid, highly lethal, trusts absolutely no one.
Suave, completely unbothered, sips tea while ordering executions.
A massive, heavily encrypted orbital listening post.
A fast, heavily shielded stealth transport.
A shadowy organization that officially does not exist.

public_situation: The {role:spy_agency} has initiated a system-wide purge of rogue assets, locking down the {role:intelligence_hub}.
private_truth: The handler is the real traitor, selling agency secrets to a rival power, and is using the purge to eliminate all the loyal spies.

beats.public_change: The agency issues a burn notice on the spy, freezing their assets and putting a bounty on their head.

missions.reason: The spy asks the pilot to scan the hub's communication arrays to find the handler's private encrypted frequency.
missions.private_fact: The frequency is broadcasting directly into enemy space.

missions.reason: The spy asks the pilot to meet a bribed technician at the hub's docking bay and collect a corrupted data drive containing the handler's logs.
missions.private_fact: The pilot has to bypass three layers of lethal biometric security to get the drive.

beats.public_change: The handler prepares to evacuate the system on a stealth shuttle.

missions.reason: The handler hires the pilot to deliver heavy bribes to the traffic controllers to clear a flight path into the dark zone.
missions.private_fact: The handler is visibly nervous and packing several bags of unmarked credits.

missions.reason: The handler hires the pilot to buy untraceable clean fuel and deliver it to their extraction shuttle.
missions.private_fact: The fuel allows the shuttle to fly without emitting a detectable ion trail.

beats.public_change: The extraction shuttle launches and vanishes off standard scanners.

missions.reason: The spy begs the pilot to run a deep scan of the dark zone using the corrupted drive's cipher to find the shuttle.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the shuttle is heavily armed and waiting for a rendezvous with enemy forces.

beats.public_change: The shuttle prepares to cross the border into enemy territory.

missions.reason: The spy pays the pilot to destroy the shuttle and recover the handler's master list of betrayals.
missions.private_fact: The handler hails the pilot, offering to add them to their payroll for life if they destroy the spy's ship instead.

player_choice.prompt: The shuttle is destroyed, and the pilot holds the master list. The handler is offering a lifetime of wealth to hand it over.

options.label: Give the list to the spy
Sell the list back to the handler

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the list to the spy.
resolutions.summary: The spy uses the list to clear their name and expose the handler. The handler is executed for treason, and the spy returns to the shadows.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a burned spy expose a massive intelligence leak.

resolutions.summary: The handler escapes to the enemy with the list. The spy is hunted down and killed. The pilot gets rich but is blacklisted by the agency.
The shuttle escapes easily. The handler successfully defects, and the spy's reputation is forever ruined, forcing them into permanent hiding.

loose_threads.detail: The handler wasn't just greedy; they were being blackmailed with footage of a terrible crime they committed years ago.
The spy's logs reveal they actually considered defecting too, but backed out at the last minute.

radio_hooks: Widespread panic as {role:spy_agency} initiates sector lockdown.
Rumors of a massive intelligence leak in the dark zone.

voice_direction.burned_spy: Low, raspy, speaks quickly and efficiently.
voice_direction.handler_officer: Smooth, perfectly calm, entirely devoid of stress.
